Defeating the Giant Enemy Crab unlocks the stage's hyper mode.
Giant Enemy Crab's pincers grow in size when damaged and regenerate after being destroyed. If the player stays below it, the crab can also summon a Drowner, which can also drop a chest. The Treasure Chest from Giant Enemy Crab can exceptionally evolve up to 5 weapons and the chest from Drowner can evolve up to 3 weapons, provided that a higher tier chest with more rewards is received.

Before version 1.0, the stage's description was as follows: "This tower hides great magical artifacts and historically accurate monsters."
This is likely a reference to the E3 2006 showing of
, a game stated to be based on Japanese history, which also includes a "giant enemy crab." An enemy named as such also appears in the stage.

Between late October 2025 and early November 2025, poncle ran an alternate reality game that is based on this stage. In this ARG, the community's goal was to discover, interpret, and discuss subtle hints and clues given out by the developers, so that players can submit answers to the password fields across the 12 floors shown in the website
